title: Field trace in a finite Galois extension is the sum of conjugates
statement: Let $F\subseteq L$ be a finite Galois extension of fields [def-weil-field], meaning a finite, separable and normal extension. Write $G=\operatorname{Aut}_F(L)$ for its finite group of field automorphisms fixing $F$. For every $x\in L$ one has, as an equality in $L$, $$\operatorname{Tr}_{L/F}(x)=\sum_{\sigma\in G}\sigma(x),$$ where the left side is mapped from $F$ to $L$ and the field trace is the trace of the $F$-linear map $z\mapsto xz$ on $L$.
